definition: to rush forward fast and out of control
description: On a steep cobbled street in a seaside town, a young woman with red hair, a flowered helmet, goggles and dungarees hurtles down the hill in an old white bathtub on iron wheels, one wheel off the ground, dust flying, between rows of hay bales. A marshal in a yellow vest dives aside. The bathtub rolls towards the camera and slows, and she pushes up her goggles and throws both arms in the air, screaming with joy. Crowds behind metal barriers and on a balcony cheer below pastel houses and a church tower.
